item.text: {"search_note":"I looked for evidence that Hasina restrained security forces, militias, allies, proxies, or clients, or that she accepted responsibility for foreseeable conduct. I found no reliable 2024 evidence of proactive restraint. I also found no meaningful proxy-war record in 2024; the relevant conduct was domestic: police, army, RAB-style security structures, and Awami League-affiliated youth violence.
